note: What FREEZE_MANIFEST.json must hash before any test run (engineering plan 5.3). Each item is a path, a glob, or `pending` until its owner names the file; a required pending or missing item keeps the manifest incomplete, and the test gate never accepts an incomplete manifest. Owners replace `pending` with `path` or `glob` when their file exists. Paths are relative to the repository root.
